description: Data layer and backend hardening: Alembic migration (4 new WorkflowRun columns + llm_usage_log table), POST /audit/resolve endpoint with validated reason codes and four-eyes check, 72h HITL timeout in both Temporal workflows, OTel tracing, Prometheus metrics, per-tenant LLM cost cap.
steps: 1. CREATE packages/synthetiq-shared/alembic/versions/h3c4d5e6f7a8_phase6_hitl_hardening.py with revision='h3c4d5e6f7a8', down_revision='g2b3c4d5e6f7'. upgrade() adds four nullable columns to workflow_runs: initiated_by VARCHAR(64), hitl_resolved_at DATETIME, hitl_resolver_id VARCHAR(64), hitl_reason_code VARCHAR(64). Also creates llm_usage_log table: id VARCHAR(64) PK, org_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, agent_name VARCHAR(64), model VARCHAR(64), input_tokens INTEGER, output_tokens INTEGER, created_at DATETIME server_default now(). Add ix_llm_usage_log_org_created index. Try RLS on llm_usage_log (PostgreSQL only, silent fail on SQLite). downgrade() drops all.

2. MODIFY packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/models/organization.py: add four Mapped columns to WorkflowRun class: initiated_by (String(64), nullable=True), hitl_resolved_at (DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True), hitl_resolver_id (String(64), nullable=True), hitl_reason_code (String(64), nullable=True). Add new ORM class LlmUsageLog(Base) in same file: __tablename__='llm_usage_log', id (String(64) PK), org_id (String(64) NOT NULL), agent_name (String(64)), model (String(64)), input_tokens (Integer), output_tokens (Integer), created_at (DateTime server_default now()). Export LlmUsageLog from synthetiq_shared/models/__init__.py.

3. MODIFY api/src/routes/audit.py: add HITLResolveRequest Pydantic model (run_id, audit_id, reason_code Literal[6 values], override_tons Optional[float], notes str, resolver_id str). Add POST /audit/resolve route: load WorkflowRun by run_id, assert_same_org, four-eyes check (resolver_id != run.triggered_by), override_tons validation (<= original_tons*1.1), Temporal signal 'human_approval' with reason_code+override_tons+resolver_id in payload, update WorkflowRun columns (hitl_required=False, hitl_resolved_at, hitl_resolver_id, hitl_reason_code). Import assert_same_org from src.middleware.rbac.

4. MODIFY worker/src/flows/workflows.py: wrap bare `await workflow.wait_condition(lambda: self._approval_received)` in BOTH QuadCoreAuditWorkflow.run() and MasterEPRComplianceWorkflow.run() with try/except asyncio.TimeoutError pattern using timeout=timedelta(hours=72). Import asyncio at top of file (add if not present). ApplicationError is already imported.

5. MODIFY api/pyproject.toml: add opentelemetry-sdk>=1.27.0, opentelemetry-instrumentation-fastapi>=0.48b0, opentelemetry-exporter-otlp>=1.27.0 (these are absent from api/pyproject.toml; worker already has them). MODIFY api/src/main.py: add OTel setup block after app = FastAPI(...) — only create TracerProvider+BatchSpanProcessor+OTLPSpanExporter if OTLP_ENDPOINT env var is set; always call FastAPIInstrumentor.instrument_app(app). MODIFY api/src/utils/tenant.py: add trace.get_current_span().set_attribute('org_id', org_id) in get_tenant_ctx() before return. MODIFY .env.example: add OTLP_ENDPOINT= entry with comment.

6. MODIFY api/src/main.py: add Instrumentator().instrument(app).expose(app) after app = FastAPI(...) (prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator is already in api/pyproject.toml). CREATE api/src/utils/metrics.py with llm_tokens_total Counter (labels: org_id, agent_name, model). CREATE worker/src/utils/__init__.py (empty) and worker/src/utils/metrics.py with identical llm_tokens_total Counter. MODIFY worker/src/factories/agent_factory.py: import counter from worker/src/utils/metrics.py, call .labels(...).inc() at end of create_agent() wrapped in try/except.

7. MODIFY worker/src/factories/agent_factory.py: add MAX_LLM_TOKENS = int(os.getenv('MAX_LLM_TOKENS_PER_ORG_PER_MONTH', '1000000')) at module top. Add async _check_cost_cap(org_id: str) function querying llm_usage_log for current-month sum(input_tokens+output_tokens); raise ApplicationError('LLM_COST_CAP_EXCEEDED: org {org_id}', non_retryable=True) if exceeded; wrapped in try/except for DB unavailability. Call await _check_cost_cap(org_id) as first line of create_agent(). Add import for ApplicationError from temporalio.exceptions.
acceptance_criteria: alembic upgrade head runs without error from packages/synthetiq-shared/
WorkflowRun ORM class has initiated_by, hitl_resolved_at, hitl_resolver_id, hitl_reason_code columns
LlmUsageLog ORM class importable from synthetiq_shared.models
MasterEPRComplianceWorkflow and QuadCoreAuditWorkflow import cleanly after timeout addition
api/src/main.py imports cleanly with OTel and Prometheus setup
create_agent() raises ApplicationError when month token sum > cap
verification: cd api && python -c "from src.main import app; print('api ok')"
cd worker && python -c "from src.flows.workflows import MasterEPRComplianceWorkflow, QuadCoreAuditWorkflow; print('workflows ok')"
cd worker && python -c "from src.factories.agent_factory import create_agent; print('factory ok')"
findings: FEAT-002 onwards: (1) POST /audit/resolve sends HumanApprovalSignal as a dict — the Temporal workflow's signal handler expects a HumanApprovalSignal dataclass; if FEAT-002 rewires the signal wire format, ensure the dataclass constructor is called in the signal handler or the handler accepts dict. (2) worker/src is added to sys.path by worker/src/main.py — all worker imports must be relative to src/ not worker/src/. (3) alembic must be run from repo root (alembic.ini is at c:/Users/HP/SynthetIQ/alembic.ini, not packages/synthetiq-shared/). (4) LlmUsageLog is now exported from synthetiq_shared.models — FEAT-002+ can import it directly.
